components.name: Chart/Race
components.description: Animated ranking over time: each frame is one period; bars re-sort (Bar) or lines grow to the current period with end labels (Line). The period sits large in the corner, Play + progress (Button · accent/default on dataviz/track) control playback; respects prefers-reduced-motion (steps instead of tweening). 5–12 entities, each keeps its colour for the whole race. Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
5–12 entities; more becomes noise.
Keep each entity’s colour fixed across frames.
Start paused — never autoplay with sound or on load in dashboards.
Offer the final frame as a static bar chart for reports.
Motion is the story
A race explains change. If only the final ranking matters, use Chart/Bar.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
